title: Megurine Luka — From The Watchtower〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: *Yawn*

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Mhm... I slept so well again today... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wow! Hiori Jidaigeki Studio Park...!
That sounds like so much fun☆

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Does that mean they'll get to see lots of samurai and ninjas?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I wish I could do a show there.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
...?
What are you all talking about?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, Luka, did you just wake up?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Tsukasa and the others were here a second ago. They told us about where they're going to be performing next, but I guess you missed all of that...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You gotta hear this. They're gonna do a show at somewhere called Hiori Jidaigeki Studio Park☆

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hiori Jidaigeki Studio Park? What is it supposed to be like...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It's a theme park where you apparently get flung back in time to Tokyo during the Edo period.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: The staff all wear period clothes and so can the guests.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You can visit the ninja house, dress up as a samurai and even go horseback riding.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: This park seems to offer a wide variety of fun activities.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, Emu even said that the grilled dango they have there looks really amazing☆

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Grilled dango? That sounds lovely.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I can already smell the soy sauce as it hits the grill...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: The smell of soy sauce as it...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And how hot, fluffy and gooey it's going to be when I put it in my mouth...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: F-Fluffy and gooey...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Nooo!
Now I wanna have some...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha. I'm also getting hungry.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm sorry.
Why don't we try a different subject?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So, what kind of show are they going to do at this park?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, they're doing a production of a show called “Ginnosuke's on the Case!”

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
“Ginnosuke's on the Case!”...?
Hehe. It certainly sounds like a historical drama.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: The story's about the namesake character, Ginnosuke, who is a constable or the equivalent of a police officer. He and his detective friend, Heihachi, work together to catch a dastardly thief!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Not only that, they'll be performing this in the park's streets!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, in the streets?
That sounds like fun.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But they've never done anything like this before. Do you think they're gonna be okay...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, it sounds really hard...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh?
I think it suits them rather well.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I mean, this Jidaigeki Studio Park is a theme park based on the Edo period, yes?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: A theme park is the perfect place for them to perform♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: They're all very good at creating a fun atmosphere, making the most of their surroundings and roping in audience members, no?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, you're right!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: They did that during their shows at Phoenix Wonderland.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: When you put it that way, I guess this type of performance does suit them rather well...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Still, Luka, I wasn't expecting to hear that from you! I have a new level of respect for you now!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Me too♪
What you just said was really cool☆

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Wait, huh..?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Zzz... Zzz...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: She fell back asleep?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
She did!
When did that happen...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
She's so quick to fall asleep.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But she still pays attention to the most important stuff.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
*Nod*
It's really impressive.
